topics.description: Investigation into Somali-owned Minnesota transportation company's contract cancellation has sparked controversy and debate. The company has called the contract cancellation 'blatant discrimination'.
topics.reason: Senators torch Soros-funded witness at fiery Minnesota Somali fraud hearing

topics.description: Newly launched DOJ fraud division has stopped $340M in schemes during its first week. The division is tasked with investigating and preventing fraud across the US.
topics.reason: DOJ fraud division stops $340M in schemes during first week
